title: PCR Protocol for Chicken Sex Identification
author: Liyan He
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uf6etre
materials: 1. Assemble all reaction components on ice in this order:   The final concentration of MgCl2 is 1.5mM and each dNTP is at 0.2mM final. 2. Seal the plate, vortex and centrifuge briefly. 3. Transfer the PCR plate into the thermocycler.

1. Prepare the Lysis Buffer: 2. Put 150 µl of lysis buffer in each 1.5 ml tube or well of 96-well plate for each sample to analyze. 3. Pipet 10~20 mg of embryo tissues from the embryo head (brain), membrane, chorion or others into the tube/well containing the lysis buffer. 4. Add 1.5 µl proteinase K at 20 mg/ml stock into each tube/well and vortex 3 seconds. 5. Incubate the tubes/plate in the thermocycler. 03:15:00 Program: · Heat lid at 60°C · Incubate 3h at 55°C · Incubate 15 min at 95°C · Hold at 4°C 6. Centrifuge 5 minutes at 13000 rpm (or 15 mins at 8000 rpm) at room temperature. 00:05:00 7. Pipet 50 µl-100 µl of the supernatant and transfer to a new 96-well plate (this primary stock solution contains the template DNA at a concentration between 500 and 1000 ng/µl per tube) and store it: - at 4°C if you are doing the PCR the same day. - at -20°C if you are going to do the PCR another day (DNA is degraded with time in biological extracts). 8. Dilute the supernatant 10 times into a new 96-well plate (For example add 10 µl of the supernatant to 90 µl of nuclease free water). It will give a final concentration of prepared template DNA between 50 and 100 ng/µl.

steps.title: Prepare primer working solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 µM primer working solution from 100 μM primer stocks for the following primer sets:

substeps.instruction: SWIM Forward: GAG ATC ACG AAC TCA ACC AG; SWIM Reverse: CCA GAC CTA ATA CGG TTT TAC AG
12S Forward: CTA TAA TCG ATA ATC CAC GAT TCA; 12S Reverse: CTT GAC CTG TCT TAT TAG CGA GG

steps.title: Analyze PCR products via agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Perform electrophoretic migration to analyze PCR products using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 μl of PCR product with 2 μl of 6X loading dye for each sample.
Load samples onto a 2.5% Gelgreen (Biotium, California USA) stained agarose gel in 0.5X TAE buffer.
Migrate DNA by electrophoresis at 100 Volts.
Use 1 μg of DNA ladder (GeneRuler 50bp, Fisher Scientific, Illkirch France) as a reference.
Reveal the gel using a Blue LED GelPicBox at 430nm (Nippongenetics, Düren Germany) or a regular UV lamp.

steps.title: Analyze PCR products via capillary electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Alternatively, use a microfluidic capillary electrophoresis system for high-throughput analysis:

substeps.instruction: Load 10 μl of the PCR reactions onto a microfluidic capillary electrophoresis system (Capillary LifeSciences, France).
Control the system using Labchip GX version 4.1.1619.0 SP1 software.

steps.title: Interpret results
steps.instruction: Determine the sample gender based on the resulting bands on the agarose gel:

substeps.instruction: Male: Only one band at 131 bp.
Female: Two bands at 131 bp and 212 bp.
Invalid: No bands appear; repeat the experiment from PCR setup.
